ORDINANCE XXVII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXVII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
FRONTIER CROSSING
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An
Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Frontier
Crossing
Regulation, 1939
[Gazette.
of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
22nd
September, 2001)
No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 22-9‑2001.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 18th September, 200,1 is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.-----This Ordinance may be called the
Balochistan Frontier Crossing (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on the 14th day of August, 2001.

Amendment of section 2 of Regulation IV of 1939

ORDINANCE XXVII OF 2001

No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV, dated 22-9‑2001.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on 18th September,
200,1 is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment
of section 2 of Regulation IV of 1939.‑‑In the Balochistan Frontier Crossing Regulation, 1939 hereinafter
referred to as the said Regulation in subsection (2) of section 2, the words
"or by the Magistrate of the District" shall be deleted.
